The '''flame ibbot''' was a [[Species/Legends|subspecies]] of [[ibbot]] that lived along the [[Boiling Sea]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall]]. The [[Diet/Legends|omnivorous]] [[Bird/Legends|birds]] were [[Color/Legends|colored]] copper, brass, or blue-black, and were capable of squirting a jet of scalding [[Water/Legends|water]] and bile at predators.

==Biology and appearance==
The flame [[ibbot]] was one of the most common members of a class<ref name="SoF" /> of sixty-eight [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Bird/Legends|birds]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall]]. Like other ibbots, the flame ibbot was specialized to fill a specific niche in Drall's ecosystem.<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> Most flame ibbots had [[Copper/Legends|copper]] or [[Brass/Legends|brass]]-colored feathers with [[Color/Legends|crimson]], orange, or white highlights. A small number of the birds had iridescent blue-black feathers with highlights of crimson or copper. Birds with the latter coloration were sought after as pets.<ref name="SoF" />

They were [[Diet/Legends|omnivorous]],<ref name="SoF" /> unlike other species of ibbot, most of which ate only [[Algae/Legends|algae]].<ref name="CatCW" /> Flame ibbots also ate algae&mdash;specifically a variety known as [[kettleweed]], which they scraped off of the rocks along the [[Boiling Sea]] on Drall&mdash;but they supplemented the [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] source with small [[Fish/Legends|fish]] and [[Insect/Legends|insects]] found in the [[Water/Legends|sea]]. The birds were medium-sized, with a wingspan of approximately two and a half [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and a height of over a meter. They possessed talons and sharp beaks.<ref name="SoF" />

The creature's name was derived from the bird's defense mechanism: flame ibbots were able to release a stream of bile and [[Temperature/Legends|hot]] water, which collected in their [[Stomach/Legends|stomachs]] as kettleweed was digested. The mixture, which could be fired up to twenty meters away, caused discomfort, disorientation, and temporary blindness in the individuals that it affected.<ref name="SoF" />

==Behavior==
Flame ibbots were mild-tempered and skilled fliers. When they felt threatened, the birds released a stream of hot water and bile at the threat. While the streams were sometimes directed at predators, they could also be directed toward tourists.<ref name="SoF" /> Flame ibbots lived in herds.<ref name="CatCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The flame ibbot was first mentioned in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="CatCW" />

''Coruscant and the Core Worlds'' establishes that the flame ibbot's wingspan is four meters wide,<ref name="CatCW" /> while [[Fantasy Flight Games]]'s sourcebook ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'' describes it to be roughly two and a half meters. As the latter source is<ref name="SoF" /> [[2014|more recent]],<ref name="Sights">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2014/1/24/set-your-sights-on-corellia|text=Set Your Sights on Corellia|date=2014-01-24}}</ref> this article assumes it to be correct.<ref name="SoF" />
